class.name: ECSScheduler
class.brief_description: Main execution heart of the ECS simulation.
class.description: The [ECSScheduler] manages the registration and execution of simulation systems. It handles both per-frame process systems and fixed-tick physics systems.

method.name: register_process_system
method.description: Adds a GDScript function or C++ callable to the main process loop.

method.name: register_physics_system
method.description: Adds a callable to the physics-rate simulation loop.

method.name: set_system_enabled
method.description: Enables or disables a specific system dynamically.

method.name: get_detailed_stats
method.description: Returns hardware telemetry and per-system timing data.
